title: ScriptEnvelope
description: The standard JSON envelope every helper script under scripts/ writes to stdout. Produced by envelope() in scripts/lib/config.js. See docs/contracts/README.md and docs/architecture.md § Contract surfaces.

ok.description: True iff errors is empty. Derived as errors.length === 0 by envelope().

mode.description: Producer-set run label (non-empty). Primary modes are 'brief' (lookback scan) and 'search' (query); helper scripts also emit operational labels such as 'context', 'draft', 'index', 'cleanup', 'discard', 'list', 'stage', 'write', and 'unknown'. The vocabulary is open — any non-empty label is valid — so a new script operation does not break the contract.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of envelope creation (new Date().toISOString()).

data.description: Tool-specific result payload, or null on fatal error / no result. Shape is defined per tool (fixtures under tests/fixtures/ capture representative payloads).

errors.description: Human-readable error strings; empty array on success. Non-empty implies ok:false.
